headline: Ondas To Acquire Aran Defense For $33 Mln; Stock Down In Pre-Market
summary: Ondas Inc. has agreed to acquire Aran Defense Ltd., the defense-focused division of Israeli engineering and manufacturing company Aran Ltd. Ondas makes autonomous drone and defense technology.
why: Ondas is a US-listed provider of drone and defense technology, and defense consolidation is a theme for technology investors. The deal adds an Israeli defense division to its portfolio.
